rab tu dga' ba'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ 'dod pas brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ rab tu byung na skad cig thang cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin brgya thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin rlabs kyang yang dag par shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byed pa dang / sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang / bskal pa brgyar gnas par byed pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa brgya yang rab tu shes pa dang / chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus kyi sprul pa brgya kun tu ston pa dang / lus re re bzhin yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor brgya brgya dang ldan par kun tu ston pa'o/[1067] / zhes gsungs so//

Their specific ability. On this point, it says:
Bodhisattvas at this level of the Joyous exert themselves diligently through aspiration. The most advanced can, within an instant, a short moment, just a fraction of time: (1) enter into to a hundredfold meditative absorptions and experience their stable fruition, (2) see a hundred buddhas, (3) most properly be aware of those buddhas’ blessings, (4) make a hundred world systems tremble, (5) visit a hundred buddhafields, (6) illuminate a hundred world systems, (7) bring a hundred sentient beings to full maturity, (8) live for a hundred eons, (9) be excellently aware of the past and future up to a hundred eons past or future, (10) open a hundred doors of Dharma, (11) manifest a hundred emanations anywhere, and (12) constantly manifest each of these physical forms as being accompanied by a hundred other bodhisattvas.[685]

d.div: [1067] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_185_na6
[685] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 125a6.

f.d: sa gnyis pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ dri ma med pa'o/ /
Its specific name is the Stainless.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de la 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi dri ma dang bral bas na dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ / de ltar yang /
'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir/ / dri ma med pa'i sa zhes brjod/[1068] / ces gsungs so/ /

Its specific etymology: This level is known as the Stainless because it is unstained by violations of moral discipline:
Being free from stains due to violations of proper conduct, it is known as the Stainless.[686] /218/

d.div: [1068] sde dge_4020_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa mgon po/ mdo sde rgyan/ le'u/ 21_sh+loka_32_shog_37_ba4
[686] Maitreya, Ornament of Mahayana Sutras (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 21:33, Toh 4020 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 37b4.

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ tshul khrims dang byas pa gzo ba la sogs pa yongs sbyong brgyad kyis sa de thob pa yin no/[1069] / de ltar yang /
tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod/ / rab tu dga' dang snying brtse che/[1070] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /

Its specific thorough preparation: This level is attained through eight kinds of mastery, such as those of moral discipline, actions, and so forth:
Moral discipline, the accomplishment of action, patience, supreme joy, great compassionate love, and so forth.[687]

d.div: [1069] bzo/ dpal spungs/
[1070] sde dge_3786_bstan/ sher phyin/ ka_byams pa mgon po/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ skabs/ 1_sh+loka_52_shog_4_na2
[687] Maitreya, Ornament of Clear Realization (Abhisamayālaṃkāra) 1:52, Toh 3786 Tengyur, shes phyin, ka, 4a2.

f.d: nyams su blang ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des/[1071] spyir pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ka nyams su len yang / khyad par tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ches shas che bar gsungs so/[1072] /
Its specific practice: Although bodhisattvas at this level practice all ten perfections, they are said to place particular emphasis on practicing the perfection of moral discipline.

d.div: [1071] byang chub sems dpa' de/ dpal spungs/
[1072] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_193_na4

f.d:
rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher rnam par dag par 'gyur te/[1073] ji skad du/
dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid gser mgar dag gis mtshur gyis bkus nas mer bcug na/ de bas kyang dri ma thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ sngar bas kyang ches rnam par dag pa dang / byang ba dang las su rung bar 'gyur ro/[1074] / zhes gsungs so/ /

Its specific purity: As previously explained, three causes make the roots of virtue created by these bodhisattvas very powerful and very pure:
To give an example, fine gold retreated and resmelted by a goldsmith will be rid of all impurities, even more so than before. Likewise, the roots of virtue of the bodhisattvas on the second level are also purer, more refined, and more workable than before.[688]

d.div: [1073] rgya che ba/ mi rigs dpe skrun/
[1074] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_193_na2
[688] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 193a4.

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa de la chos kyi dbyings mchog gi don du rtogs te/ des 'di snyam du/ bdag gis rnam pa thams cad du yongs su sbyang ba mngon par bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o snyam mo/ / de ltar yang /
mchog gi don/[1075] zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization: On this level, the ultimate expanse is understood as being the highest and most significant thing. They think, “I will strive at all times and in all ways in the training through which it is really and totally achieved.” Thus it is said:
Highest thing. [689]

d.div: [1075] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_14_shog_42_na7
[689] Maitreya, Clear Differentiation of the Middle and Extremes (Madhyāntavibhāga) 2:16a, Toh 4021 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 42a7.

f.d: spang pa'i khyad par ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bzung nas bcu pa'i bar 'dis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i dbang du byas na/ sgom spangs kyi nyon mongs pa bcu drug yod pa las/ de rnams kyi sa bon tsam ni mi spong bar 'jog la/ mngon gyur rnams ni mgo gnon pa yin no/[1076] / shes bya'i sgrib pa'i dbang du byas na spyi la yod pa lta bu rnams spong ba yin no/ /

The specific things abandoned for this second level, and on through to the tenth level: As far as the afflictions are concerned, only the seeds of the sixteen afflictions that need to be eliminated by the path of cultivation have not been removed and remain present. However, their manifest levels have been overcome. As for the knowledge obscurations, the inner layer, like the flesh of a fruit, is eliminated.

d.div: [1076] mgo non/ dpal spungs/

f.d:
skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ phal cher gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur te/ sems can rnams mi dge ba bcu'i las las bzlog nas dge ba bcu'i las la 'god do/ / de ltar yang /
de yi rnam par smin pas ni/ / dpal ldan rin chen bdun dag gis/ / 'gro phan 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/[1077] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific state of birth: Many of the bodhisattvas on this level become universal monarchs holding sway over the four-world system. There they turn beings away from the ten vices and establish them in the ten virtues. Thus:
Through the full maturation of this, they become universal monarchs who benefit beings through possessing the seven precious and illustrious attributes.[690]

d.div: [1077] sde dge_4158_bstan/ spring yig_ge_mgon po klu sgrub/ rin chen phreng ba/ le'u/ 5_sh+loka_44_shog_123_ba5
[690] Nāgārjuna, Ratnāvalī 5:44, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, ge, 133b5.

f.d: mthu'i khyad par ni/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin stong thob pa la sogs pa dang sbyar ro//
The specific ability is that, in one instant, a short moment, a fraction of time, they can enter into a thousand meditative absorptions and so forth.[691]

d.div: [691] “And so forth” refers back to the list of twelve specific abilities mentioned for the first bodhisattva level, the only difference being in their numbers. For instance, on the first level, it was hundred, on the second level thousand, on the third ten thousand, and so on.

f.d: sa gsum pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ 'od byed pa'o/ /
Its specific name is the Shining.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de la chos dang ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba gsal ba dang / gzhan dag la chos kyi snang ba chen po byed pas na 'od byed pa zhes bya'o/ / de ltar yang /
chos kyi snang ba chen po ni/ / byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa'o/[1078] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific etymology: /219/ It is known as the Shining because in that state the light of Dharma and of meditative absorption is very clear. Furthermore, it illuminates others with the great light of Dharma. Thus it is said:
It is the Shining because it makes the great radiance of Dharma.[692]

d.div: [1078] sde dge_4020_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa mgon po/ mdo sde rgyan/ le'u/ 20_sh+loka_33_shog_37_ba4
[692] Maitreya, Ornament of Mahayana Sutras (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 20:33, Toh 4020 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 37b4.

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ thos pas mi ngoms pa la sogs chos lnga la bslabs pas sa de thob pa yin no/ / de ltar yang /
thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ / zang zing med par chos sbyin dang /[1079] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /

The specific thorough preparation: This level is achieved through having developed five things, such as an insatiable appetite for studying [Dharma]. As is taught:
Insatiable with respect to Dharma study, they impart teachings without material concern.[693]

d.div: [1079] sde dge_3786_bstan/ sher phyin/ ka_byams pa mgon po/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ skabs/ 1_sh+loka_53_shog_4_na4
[693] Maitreya, Ornament of Clear Realization (Abhisamayālaṃkāra) 1:53, Toh 3786 Tengyur, shes phyin, ka, 4a3.

f.d: nyams su blang bya'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des spyir pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ka nyams su len yang khyad par du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ches shas che bar gsungs so/ /
The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas at this level practice all ten perfections, they are said to place particular emphasis on practicing the perfection of patience.

rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/
dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid gser mgar mkhas pa'i lag na bsrel na/ dang po'i srang grangs kyi tshad las nyung du mi 'gro bar/ skyon dang dri ma thams cad zad par byed do/ / de bzhin du sa gsum pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni mi 'grib par gnas shing / shin tu dag pa dang byang ba dang las su rung bar 'gyur ro/[1080] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As explained above, three causes make the roots of virtue of these bodhisattvas very great and very pure:
To give an example, if very fine gold is hand-polished by a skilled goldsmith, the defects and impurities are removed, yet this does not reduce the original weight of the gold itself. Likewise, the roots of virtue, established in the three periods of time by these bodhisattvas, remain undiminished and become very pure, very refined, and fit for any use.[694]

d.div: [1080] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_201_na7
[694] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 201a7.

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des chos kyi dbyings de'i rgyu mthun pa'i chos don gyi mchog tu rtogs te/ des tshigs su bcad pa re re tsam thos pa'i phyir yang me'i 'obs stong gsum tsam du bdag nyid mchong bar byed do/ / de ltar yang /
rgyu mthun mchog gi don nyid dang /[1081] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization: Bodhisattvas on this level understand the teachings of Dharma to be supreme among the favorable conditions conducive to [realizing] the ultimate expanse. To study just one verse of teaching, they would pass through a fire pit as large as a billionfold world system. Therefore,
the supreme of meanings, which is conducive. [695]

d.div: [1081] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_14_shog_42_na7
[695] Maitreya, Clear Differentiation of the Middle and Extremes (Madhyāntavibhāga) 2:16b, Toh 4021 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 42a7.

f.d: The specific things abandoned: See the second level, above.

skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de phal cher lha'i dbang po brgya byin du 'gyur te/ sems can rnams kyi 'dod pa'i 'dod chags zlog pa la mkhas so/[1082] / de ltar yang /
lha yi dbang chen mkhas pa ste/ / 'dod pa'i 'dod chags zlog pa yin/[1083] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take rebirth as Indra, king of the gods. They are skilled in counteracting desires and attachments related to the desire realm:
They become skillful great masters of the gods, who counteract attachment of the desire realm.[696]

d.div: [1082] bzlog_dpal spungs/
[1083] sde dge_4158_bstan/ spring yig_ge_mgon po klu sgrub/ rin chen phreng ba/ le'u/ 5_sh+loka_45_shog_123_ba6
[696] Nāgārjuna, Precious Garland (Ratnāvalī) 5:46cd, Toh 4158 Tengyur, sprin yig, ge, 123b6.

f.d: mthu'i khyad par ni/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin 'bum thob pa la sogs pa sbyar ro//
The specific ability: In an instant, a short moment of time, a small fraction of time, they can enter a hundred thousand meditative absorptions and so forth.
sa bzhi pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ 'od 'phro ba'o/ /
Its specific name is the Blazing.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de la byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos rnams kyi ye shes kyi 'od 'phro bas/ sgrib pa gnyis bsregs pas na 'od 'phro ba zhes bya'o/ / de ltar yang /
'di ltar byang chub mi mthun chos/ / rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu/ / de ldan phyir na sa de ni/ / gnyis po bsregs pas 'od 'phro can/[1084] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific etymology: It is called the Blazing because the brilliance of pristine awareness, endowed with the qualities favorable to enlightenment, blazes everywhere, having consumed the two obscurations. /220/ Thus:
It is like a light since it thoroughly consumes the factors incompatible with enlightenment. Thus endowed, this level is Blazing, because the two have been consumed.[697]

d.div: [1084] sde dge_4020_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa mgon po/ mdo sde rgyan/ le'u/ 21_sh+loka_34_shog_37_ba4
[697] Maitreya, Ornament of Mahayana Sutras (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 20:34, Toh 4020 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 37b4.

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ dgon par gnas par bya ba la sogs pa bcus sa de thob pa yin no/ / de ltar yang /
nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang / sbyangs pa yang dag sdom bsten dang /[1085] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /

The specific thorough preparation: This level is achieved through ten factors, such as remaining in solitude and so forth. Therefore:
Remaining in forests, with little desire, easily contented, pure in behavior, observing vows. [698]

d.div: [1085] sde dge_3786_bstan/ sher phyin/ ka_byams pa mgon po/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ skabs/ 1_sh+loka_54_shog_4_na3
[698] Maitreya, Ornament of Clear Realization (Abhisamayālaṃkāra) 1:53, Toh 3786 Tengyur, shes phyin, ka, 4a3.

f.d: nyams su blang bya'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des spyir pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ka nyams su len yang khyad par du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ches shas che bar gsungs so/[1086] /
The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas on this level practice all the ten perfections in general, it is said that they place particular emphasis on that of diligence.

d.div: [1086] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_209_na5

f.d:
rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des de dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher rnam par dag par 'gyur te/[1087] ji skad du/
dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid gser mgar mkhas pas rgyan gyi rnam par byas pa ni/ rgyan du ma byas pa'i gser rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/ / de bzhin du sa bzhi pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang / sa 'og ma dag la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1088] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As explained above, three causes make the roots of virtue of these bodhisattvas extremely great and pure:
To give an example, fine gold fashioned into a piece of jewelry by a skilled goldsmith cannot be surpassed by pieces of gold as yet unworked. In a similar way, the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this level are not outshone by those of bodhisattvas on lower levels.[699]

d.div: [1087] de'i/ mi rigs dpe skrun/
[1088] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_208_ba7
[699] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 208b7.

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i don du rtogs te/ 'di ltar chos la sred pa yang ldog go / de ltar yang /
yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang /[1089]/ zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization: Bodhisattvas on this level have truly realized that there is nothing whatsoever to really cling to. Thus all craving, even for Dharma, is quenched:
The fact that there is nothing to really cling to and. [700]

d.div: [1089] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_14_shog_42_na7
[700] Maitreya, Clear Differentiation of the Middle and Extremes (Madhyāntavibhāga) 2:16c, Toh 4021 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 42a7.

f.d: The specific things abandoned: See the second level, above.

skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de phal cher lha'i rgyal po rab 'thab bral du 'gyur te/ sems can rnams kyi 'jig tshogs kyi lta ba 'joms pa la mkhas so/ / de ltar yang /
rab mtha' bral gnas lha rgyal 'gyur/ / 'jig tshogs lta ba rab byung ba/ / kun nas 'joms byed mkhas pa yin/[1090] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take birth as a king of gods in the Free from Conflict Heaven. They are skilled in dispelling mistaken philosophies based on the view that the perishable composite is permanent. Thus:
They become divine monarchs in the Free from Conflict Heaven and are skilled in totally defeating views of the perishable composite where these are predominant.[701]

d.div: [1090] sde dge_4158_bstan/ spring yig_ge_mgon po klu sgrub/ rin chen phreng ba/ le'u/ 5_sh+loka_46_shog_123_ba7
[701] Nāgārjuna, Precious Garland (Ratnāvalī) 5:48, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, ge, 123b7.

f.d: mthu'i khyad par ni/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin bye ba thob pa la sogs pa sbyar ro//
The specific ability: In one moment, a short instant, a fraction of time, they can enter a billion meditative absorptions and so forth.
sa lnga pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ shin tu sbyang dka' ba'o/ /
Its specific name is Difficult to Master.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de la sems can smin par byed pa la brtson yang sems can gyi log par sgrub pas kun nas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis ka sbyang dka' ba'i phyir sbyang dka' ba zhes bya'o/[1091] / de ltar yang /
sems can don ni bsgrub pa dang / / rang gi sems kyang bsrung bas na/ / blo ldan rnams kyis sbyang dka' ba/ / de phyir sbyang dka' zhes bya'o/[1092] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific etymology: On this level the bodhisattva strives to help beings to greater maturity, and in doing so they remain unassailed by the afflictions despite the repeated negative behavior of sentient beings. It is known as Difficult to Master because both [helping and not reacting] are hard to master. /221/ Thus:
Since they accomplish the good of beings and guard their own minds, it is a difficult training for the bodhisattvas; therefore it is known as Difficult to Master.[702]

d.div: [1091] bya dka'/ dpal spungs/
[1092] sde dge_4020_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa mgon po/ mdo sde rgyan/ le'u/ 21_sh+loka_35_shog_37_ba5
[702] Maitreya, Ornament of Mahayana Sutras (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 21:35, Toh 4020 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 32b5.

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ rnyed sogs kyi don du khyim pa dang 'dris par byed pa la sogs bcu spangs pas sa de thob pa yin no/ / de ltar yang /
'dris dang khyim la'ang 'khren pa dang / / 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas dang ni/[1093] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /

The specific thorough preparation: This level is achieved through the elimination of ten factors, such as association with worldly people for purposes of gain and so forth. For instance:
To hanker after acquaintances, a dwelling, places brimming with distraction, and so forth. [703]

d.div: [1093] sde dge_3786_bstan/ sher phyin/ ka_byams pa mgon po/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ skabs/ 1_sh+loka_56_shog_4_na4
[703] Maitreya, Ornament of Clear Realization (Abhisamayālaṃkāra) 1:56, Toh 3786 Tengyur, shes phyin, ka, 4a4.

f.d: nyams su blang bya'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des spyir pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ka nyams su len yang / khyad par du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ches shas che bar gsungs so/[1094] /
The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas on this level practice all ten perfections in general, it is said that they place particular emphasis on that of meditative absorption.

d.div: [1094] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_216_na3

f.d:
rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/
dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid gser mgar mkhas pas byi dor byas pa de la rin po che spugs kyis spras na mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir/ de ma yin pa'i gser dag gis mi 'phrog pa yin no// de bzhin du sa lnga pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang thabs shes rab gnyis kyis dpyad pas rnam par dag ste/ sa 'og ma la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1095] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As previously explained, three causes make the roots of virtue of these bodhisattvas particularly great and pure:
To give an example, fine gold, first polished by a skilled goldsmith and then set with amber stones, will be incomparably beautiful; it cannot be outshone by other pieces made of [worked] gold alone. It is likewise for the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this fifth level. They are tested by the combination of wisdom and skillful means. They could never be outshone by the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on lower levels.[704]

d.div: [1095] gong mtshungs/ sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_215_ba6
[704] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 215b6.

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des rgyud tha dad med pa'i don rtogs te/ mnyam pa nyid bcu shes so/ / de ltar yang /
rgyud rnams tha dad med pa dang /[1096] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization is that bodhisattvas on this level realize the non-differentiation of [mind] streams. They are aware of ten sorts of sameness. Thus,
“Undifferentiated streams and. ”[705]

d.div: [1096] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_14_shog_42_na7

[705] Maitreya, Clear Differentiation of the Middle and Extremes (Madhyāntavibhāga) 2:16d, Toh 4021 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 42a7. “Ten sorts of sameness” refers to a list found in the Ten Levels Sutra where, in presenting the emptiness of all phenomena, the sutra identifies two basic kinds of sameness—the sameness of all phenomena with respect to their absence of inherent existence and the sameness of all phenomena with respect to their absence of signs. These two are then explained further in terms of eight kinds of sameness.

f.d: The specific things abandoned: See the second level.

skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ phal cher lha'i rgyal po dga' ldan du skye bar 'gyur te/ mu stegs rnams kyi lta bzlog pa la mkhas pa'o/ / de ltar yang /
de yi rnam par smin pas ni/ / dga' ldan gnas kyi lha rgyal 'gyur/ / mu stegs byed pa thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs lta gnas bzlog par byed/[1097] / ces gsungs so/ /

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take birth as divine monarchs in Tuṣita Heaven. They are skilled in refuting the views of those holding distorted religious beliefs. Therefore:
As a full consequence of that they become monarchs of the Tuṣita gods and are skilled in refuting the foundations of the afflictions and distorted beliefs of all tīrthikas.[706]

d.div: [1097] sde dge_4158_bstan/ spring yig_ge_mgon po klu sgrub/ rin chen phreng ba/ le'u/ 5_sh+loka_51_shog_124_na1
[706] Nāgārjuna, Precious Garland (Ratnāvalī) 5:50, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, 124a1.

f.d: mthu'i khyad par ni/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin bye ba phrag stong thob pa la sogs pa sbyar ro//
The specific ability: In one instant, a short moment, a small fraction of time, they can enter ten billion meditative absorptions and so forth.
sa drug pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ mngon du 'gyur pa'o/ /
Its specific name is the Manifested.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas/[1098] 'khor 'das gnyis la mi gnas pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dag la mngon du gyur bas na/ mngon du gyur ba zhes bya'o/ / de ltar yang /
shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ / 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ / gnyis 'di mngon du gyur ba'i phyir/ / mngon du gyur ba'i sa zhes bshad/[1099] / ces gsungs so/ /

The specific etymology: On account of the perfection of wisdom, there is no dwelling in [notions of] nirvana or samsara. /222/ Thus samsara and nirvana manifest as purity.[707] Hence the name of this level, the Manifested:
Through the perfection of wisdom, since both samsara and nirvana have become manifest, it is called the Manifested.[708]

d.div: [1098] sa de la/ dpal spungs/
[1099] sde dge_4020_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa mgon po/ mdo sde rgyan/ le'u/ 21_sh+loka_36_shog_37_ba5

[707] As long as samsara or nirvana seem real, separate from and different from each other, the mind falls into the general “impurity” of being sway to concepts. The profound wisdom of this sixth level reveals mind’s innate and pristine purity, and this automatically dispels such dualistic elaborations.
[708] Maitreya, Ornament of Mahayana Sutras (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 21:36, Toh 4020 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 32b5.

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ sbyin pa la sogs chos drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la bslab pa dang / nyan rang la 'dod pa la sogs chos drug spang ba la bslab pa ste/ de ltar bcu gnyis kyis sa de thob pa yin no// de ltar yang /
sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ / bsam gtan shes rab rab rdzogs pas/[1100] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /

The specific thorough preparation: This level is achieved through twelve factors of training. These are learning how to accomplish totally and perfectly six things, such as generosity and so forth, and learning how to eliminate six things, such as longing for the śrāvaka or pratyekabuddha [states] and the like. Therefore:
Through the utter perfection of generosity, moral discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom, there is awareness and so forth.[709]

d.div: [1100] sde dge_3786_bstan/ sher phyin/ ka_byams pa mgon po/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ skabs/ 1_sh+loka_58_shog_4_na5
[709] Maitreya, Ornament of Clear Realization (Abhisamayālaṃkāra) 1:57, Toh 3786 Tengyur, shes phyin, ka, 4a5.

The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas on this level practice all ten perfections in general, it is said that they place particular emphasis on that of the perfection of deep wisdom.

d.div: [1101] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_225_ba2

f.d:
rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/
dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid gser mgar mkhas pas rin po che baiDUR+yas spras na mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir de ma yin pa'i gser thams cad kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/ / de bzhin du sa drug pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang thabs dang shes rab kyis dpyad pas rnam par dag cing 'od gsal te/ de ma yin pa'i sa 'og ma la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1102]/zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As explained previously, three causes make the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this level extremely pure and powerful:
To give an example, when a skilled goldsmith decorates fine gold with lapis lazuli, it becomes peerless and cannot be surpassed by other works of gold. Likewise, the roots of virtue of sixth-level bodhisattvas, assured by wisdom and skillful means, are both total purity and lucid clarity; they cannot be outshone by those of bodhisattvas dwelling on lower levels.[710]

d.div: [1102] gong mtshungs/ sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_215_na5
[710] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 215a5.

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa des kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par dag pa ma yin pa'i don du rtogs te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la gang kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ gang rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i chos gang yang med par shes so/ / de ltar yang /
nyon mongs rnam dag min don dang /[1103] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization: On this level the bodhisattva realizes the non-existence of both the afflictions and their purification. These bodhisattvas are aware that there are really no such things as affliction or purity, even though those things may arise through the play of dependent origination. Thus it is said:
“. . . the meaning of no affliction and no purity.”[711]

d.div: [1103] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_15_shog_42_na1
[711] Maitreya, Clear Differentiation of the Middle and Extremes (Madhyāntavibhāga) 2:17a, Toh 4021 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 42a1.

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take birth as a divine monarch among the Delighting in Manifesting gods. They are skilled in overcoming beings’ vanity:
Through this full consequence, they become kings of the Delighting in Manifesting gods. Unsurpassed by the śrāvakas, they eliminate vainglory.[712]

Its specific name is the Far-Reaching.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang 'brel ba'i phyir ring du song ba yin te spyod pa'i mthar song ba'i phyir ro/[1105] / de ltar yang /

The specific etymology: This level is known as the Far-Reaching because it connects with the “one and only path” and one has come to the far end of activity:
It is known as the Far-Reaching level because it connects with the sole path.[713]

The specific thorough preparation: This level is achieved through eliminating twenty factors, such as grasping at self, and through cultivating the opposite qualities, such as the three gates of total liberation and so forth. Therefore:
“Grasping at self and persons. ”[714] and
“Awareness of the three gates of total liberation. ”[715]

The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas on this level practice all ten perfections in general, it is said that they place particular emphasis on that of skillful means.

The specific purity: As explained previously, three causes make the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this level extremely pure and powerful:
To give an example, when a skilled goldsmith decorates finest gold with all sorts of precious gems, it becomes most beautiful and cannot be excelled by other pieces of jewelry in this world. Likewise the roots of virtue of seventh-level bodhisattvas are extraordinarily great and pure; they cannot be excelled by those of śrāvakas, pratyekabuddha, or bodhisattvas established on lower levels.[716]

[716] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 236a2.

rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des tha dad du med pa'i don rtogs te/ mdo la sogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan ma tha dad mi 'byung ngo / / de ltar yang /

The specific realization: On this level the truth of the absence of differentiation is realized. All the various characteristics of Dharma, the sutras, and so forth do not appear as separate. Thus it is said:
“The truth of no-differentiation. ”[717]

d.div: [1111] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_15_shog_42_na1

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take rebirth as a divine monarch among the Delighting in Others’ Manifestations[718] gods. They are skilled in bringing about realizations of the śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas:
Through this full consequence, they become kings of the Delighting in Others’ Manifestations gods. They become great, outstanding Dharma masters with a genuine understanding of the [four] noble truths.[719] /224/

d.div: [1112] sde dge_4158_bstan/ spring yig_ge_mgon po klu sgrub/ rin chen phreng ba/ le'u/ 5_sh+loka_55_shog_224_na4

[718] Tib. dbang sgyur or gzhan ’phrul dbang byed, Skt. paranirmitavaśavartin. These gods are the highest within the desire realm and exercise dominion over others’ manifestations for their own enjoyment.
[719] Nāgārjuna, Precious Garland (Ratnāvalī) 5:54, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, ge, 224a4.

The specific ability: In one instant, a short moment, a small fraction of time, they can enter a hundred quadrillion meditative absorptions and so forth.
sa brgyad pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ mi g.yo ba'o/ /
Its specific name is the Unshakable.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ mtshan ma la rtsol ba'i 'du shes dang / mtshan ma med pa la rtsol ba'i 'du shes kyis mi g.yo ba'i phyir ro/ / de ltar yang /
'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo'i phyir/ / mi g.yo ba zhes mngon par brjod/[1113] / ces gsungs so/ /

The specific etymology: It is so called because it is unmoved by notions that either strive after characteristics or the absence of characteristics. Therefore:
It is known as the Unshakable since it is unmoved by the two notions.[720]

d.div: [1113] sde dge_4020_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa mgon po/ mdo sde rgyan/ le'u/ 21_sh+loka_37_shog_37_ba6
[720] Maitreya, Ornament of Mahayana Sutras (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 21:37, Toh 4020 Tengyur, sems tsam, phi, 32b6.

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa la sogs pa yongs su sbyong ba brgyad kyis sa de thob pa yin no/ / de ltar yang /
sems can kun yid shes pa dang / / mngon par shes pas rtse ba dang /[1114] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so//

The specific thorough prepration: This level is achieved through eight kinds of mastery, such as understanding the behavior of sentient beings and so forth. Therefore:
Awareness of the mind of every being, love due to clear cognition. [721]

d.div: [1114] sde dge_3786_bstan/ sher phyin/ ka_byams pa mgon po/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ skabs/ 1_sh+loka_67_shog_4_ba3

The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas on this level practice all ten perfections in general, it is said that they place particular emphasis on that of aspirational prayers.

d.div: [1115] sde dge_44_bka'/ phal chen/ kha_sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_248_na1

f.d:
rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/
dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid mgar ba mkhas pas rgyan du zin par byas te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi bdag po'i mgo'am mgul par btags na/ 'dzam bu gling ba'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyan gyi dam pa rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1116] / de bzhin du sa brgyad pa la gnas pa'i byang sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ nyan rang thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa bdun pa la gnas pa'i bar dag gis mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1117] / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As explained previously, three causes make the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this level extremely pure and powerful:
To give an example, were a fine piece of golden jewelry, made by a master goldsmith, to be worn on the head or the throat of a ruler of Jambudvīpa, it could not be surpassed by gold ornaments worn by other people. Likewise, the roots of virtue of eighth-level bodhisattvas are so utterly and perfectly pure that they cannot be excelled by those of śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, or bodhisattvas established on lower levels.[722]

d.div: [1116] rgyan gyi rnam pa/ dpal spungs/

[722] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 247b3.

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa des chos thams cad rnam par rtog pa'i 'du shes dang bral zhing nam mkha' dang 'dra bar khong du chud pas stong nyid skye med kyi don la mi dngangs mi skrag ste/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa zhes bya'o/ / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pas bri ba med cing / 'phel ba med pa'i don rtogs te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba yang bri ba'am/ 'phel ba mi mthong ba'o/ / de ltar yang /
bri med 'phel ba med don dang /[1118] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization: On this level the space-like and concept-free nature of every phenomenon is realized. Therefore its bodhisattvas are not shocked and frightened by emptiness—the unborn. This is known as the achievement of forbearance concerning the unborn. Through this forbearance of the unborn nature of everything, they realize the nonexistence of increase and decrease and do not consider the really afflicted or the totally pure as either decreasing or increasing, respectively. Hence:
“No increase, no decrease. ”[723] /225/

d.div: [1118] sde dge_4021_bstan/ sems tsam/ phi_byams pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ le'u/ 2_sh+loka_15_shog_42_na1

yang /
dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas/[1119] / zhes gsungs te/ rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba dang / zhing yongs su dag pa la dbang ba dang / ye shes la dbang ba dang / las la dbang ba dang bzhi yod pa las/ sa brgyad pa la gnas pa des/ rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba dang / zhing yongs su dag pa la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs so/ / gzhan yang sa brgyad pa la gnas pa des/ dbang rnam pa bcu yang thob par gsungs so/ / de la dbang rnam pa bcu ni/ tshe la dbang ba dang / de bzhin du/ sems la/ yo byad la/ las la/ skye ba la/ smon lam la/ mos pa la/ rdzu 'phrul la/ ye shes la/ chos la dbang ba'o/ /

It is also said that:
This is also [the first of] the states with the four powers.[724] The four powers are: (1) power over nonconceptuality, (2) power over very pure realms, (3) power over pristine awareness, and (4) power over actions. Of these four, bodhisattvas on the eighth level have realized the first two powers, those of nonconceptuality and of very pure realms. Furthermore, it is said [in other scriptural sources] that those on the eighth level have achieved the ten powers, the powers over lifespan, mind, commodities, action, birth state, prayer, intentions, miracles, pristine awareness, and Buddhadharma.

skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de phal cher stong spyi phud la dbang ba'i rgyal po tshangs par 'gyur te/ dgra bcom pa dang / rang rgyal ba la sogs pa'i don gtan la 'bebs pa'o/ / de ltar yang /

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take rebirth as a divine monarch among the Brahma gods with power over an entire thousandfold world system. They are skilled in expounding the meaning of the śrāvaka and pratyekabuddha paths:
The full consequence is to take birth as a Brahma god, lord of a thousandfold world systems. They are unsurpassed by śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas in the exposition of the doctrines.[725]

d.div: [1120] sde dge_4158_bstan/ spring yig_ge_mgon po klu sgrub/ rin chen phreng ba/ le'u/ 5_sh+loka_57_shog_224_na5

The specific ability: In one instant, a short moment, a small fraction of time, they can enter as many meditative absorptions as the number of particles in a quadrillion world systems and so forth.

That level is the Excellent Intelligence because of its good intelligence, clearly discerning.[726]

The infinite number of prayers. . . and the knowledge of divine languages.[727]

dper na gser sa le sbram de nyid gser mgar mkhas pas rgyan du byas pa de/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i mgo'am mgul du btags na/ khams kyi rgyal po rnams dang / gling bzhi pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyan gyi dam pa rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1125] / de bzhin du sa dgu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ye shes kyi snang ba chen pos brgyan pa/ nyan rang thams cad dang sa 'og ma la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1126] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As explained previously, three causes make the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this level extremely pure and powerful:
To give an example, were a fine piece of golden jewelry, made by a master goldsmith, to be worn on the head or throat of a universal monarch, /226/ it could be excelled neither by the pieces of jewelry worn by the kings of the various regions nor by those worn by any of the inhabitants of the four continents [of that world system]. Likewise, the roots of virtue of ninth-level bodhisattvas are so adorned with great pristine awareness that they cannot be excelled by those of śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, or bodhisattvas established on lower levels.[728]

f.d:
rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ dbang bzhi po de las ye shes la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs te/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa'i phyir ro/ / so so yang dag par rig pa gang zhe na/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las/
so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang / don so so yang dag par rig pa dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa dang / spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa rtag par rgyun du 'byung ngo /[1127] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific realization: Of the four powers [mentioned in the previous section], bodhisattvas at this ninth level realize the state of the power of pristine awareness, since they have achieved the four modes of perfectly clear, discerning knowledge. What are the four modes of perfectly clear, discerning knowledge? The Ten Levels Sutra explains:
What are the four modes of clear discerning knowledge? They are constant possession of: perfectly clear discerning knowledge of Dharma, perfectly clear discerning knowledge of meanings, perfectly clear discerning knowledge of definitions, and perfectly clear discerning knowledge of teaching skill.[729]

d.div: [1127] gong mtshungs/ sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_254_ba1

f.d: The specific things abandoned: See the second level.

skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de phal cher stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams la dbang ba'i lha'i rgyal po tshangs par 'gyur te/ dris pa thams cad kyi lan 'debs par byed do/ / de ltar yang /
de yi rnam par smin pa ni/ stong gnyis bdag po tshangs par 'gyur/ / sems can bsam pa dris pa las/ / dgra bcom sogs kyis 'phrog pa med/[1128] / ces gsungs so/ /

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take birth as a divine monarch among the Brahma gods with power over a millionfold world system. They are able to answer all questions:
The full consequence is to take birth as Brahma, lord of a millionfold world systems. In dispelling qualms from the minds of sentient beings, they are unsurpassed by arhats and the like.[730]

[730] Nāgārjuna, Precious Garland (Ratnāvalī) 5:56, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, ge, 224a6.

f.d: mthu'i khyad par ni/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thob pa la sogs pa sbyar ro/ /

The specific ability: In one instant, a short moment, a small fraction of time, they can enter as many meditative absorptions as there are pure particles in a million countless[731] buddhafields and so forth.

d.div: [731] “Countless” is the last of the series of names that ancient India had for each multiple of ten, from 100 up to 1051. This extraordinary range of names was needed for comparing differences in lifespan and so forth in the various levels of the cosmos.

f.d: sa bcu pa'i
ming gi khyad par ni/ chos kyi sprin no/ /
Its specific name is the Cloud of Dharma.

nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ sa de la gnas pas ni sprin bzhin du chos kyi char phab nas/ sems can gyi nyon mongs pa'i rdul phra rab zhi bar byed pas na chos kyi sprin no/ / yang na sprin bzhin du ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo thob pa'i chos la yod pa nam mkha' lta bu la khyab pa'i phyir chos kyi sprin zhes bya'o/[1129] / de ltar yang /
sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i chos/ / khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin/[1130] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific etymology: It is called the Cloud of Dharma because the bodhisattvas on that level are like a cloud that causes a rain of Dharma teachings to fall on beings, thereby washing away the fine dust of their afflictions. Alternatively, like clouds filling space, their meditative absorptions and the retention dhāraṇī they have attained pervade the entire space-like reality. Therefore:
It is the Cloud of Dharma because like clouds, the two [meditative absorptions and dhāraṇis] pervade the space-like reality.[732]

f.d:
yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las ma bstan te/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las/[1131]
kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' de ltar sa dgu'i bar du shes bya tshad med pa la rnam par brtag pa'i blos shin tu rnam par phye ba/ rnam par 'byed pa/[1132] zhes pa la sogs pa yongs su sbyong ba bcus thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang bskur ba'i sa thob par gsungs so/ / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang bskur ba'i sa zhes pa ni sa bcu pa'o/ /

The specific thorough preparation: [Unlike for the previous levels,] there is no presentation of this level in the Ornament of Clear Realization, but in the Ten Levels Sutra it says: /227/
O children of the victors! Up to the ninth level, bodhisattvas have thoroughly analyzed and do thoroughly analyze immeasurable aspects of knowledge with an investigatory intelligence.[733] Through such statements, we see the teaching that this level is achieved through an empowerment of pristine awareness of omniscience due to ten thorough preparations. This tenth level is the “level empowered by omniscient pristine awareness.”

d.div: [1131] 'phags pa/ zhes pa dpal spungs dpar mar med/

[733] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44, phal chen kha, 261b2.

f.d:
sa bcu pa la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang bskur ba'i sa zer ba ci ste zhe na/ sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis/ 'od zer gyis dbang bskur ba'i phyir te/ rgyas par ni sa bcu pa'i mdo las shes par bya'o/ / rin chen phreng ba las kyang /
byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi/ / 'od zer dbang gis dbang bskur phyir/[1133] / zhes gsungs so/ /

Why is it so called? Because, as the Ten Levels Sutra explains, the bodhisattvas on the tenth level are empowered with light by the buddhas of the ten directions. Further details can be found in that sutra. The Precious Garland also says:
. . . because the bodhisattva is empowered by rays of light from the buddhas.[734]

[734] Nāgārjuna, Ratnāvalī 5:59, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, ga, 224a6.

f.d: (byams pa dang byams pa'i TIka las kyang de ltar gsungs/ gsang sngags nas sa bcu pa'i mthar byang chub sems dpa' de la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi dbang bskur bas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa de dang / 'dir smos pa gnyis gcig pa yin te/ dri ba lan mi 'dra yang don la 'gal ba med do//)[1134]

(This is the interpretation of Maitreya and that found in the commentaries of his tradition. It is said in the tantras that at the end of the tenth level, bodhisattvas receive empowerment from the buddhas of the ten directions and themselves become buddhas. These two views are in fact the same. Different questions attract different answers, but there is no contradiction between the two.)[735]

d.div: [1134] byams pa dang byams pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ don la 'gal ba med da/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi yig chung 'di rnams dpal spungs dpar mar mi byung bas brtag

[735] This passage is in reduced print in the Tsipri xylograph, which is the basis of the critical Tibetan edition produced for The Library of Tibetan Classics series. To indicate this, we have presented it within parenthesis. This entire parenthetical paragraph is not found in the Palpung edition, which suggests the possibility that it could be a later addition by an editor.

The specific practice: Although bodhisattvas on this level practice all ten perfections in general, it is said that they place particular emphasis on that of pristine awareness.[736]

[736] Ten Levels Sutra (Daśabhūmikasūtra), Toh 44 Kangyur, phal chen, kha, 274b1.

f.d:
rnam par dag pa'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rgyu gsum po des de'i dge ba rtsa ba rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/
dper na lha'i rgyan chen po mkhan po dang bzo bos ma byas pa/ nor bu rin po ches spras pa de lha'i rgyal po dbang bsgyur gyi mgo'am mgul du btags na/ de ma yin pa'i lha dang mi'i rgyan gyi rnam pa dag gis mi 'phrog pa yin no/ / de bzhin du sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi rgyu de dag kyang / sems can thams cad dang / nyan rang thams cad dang / sa dgu pa man chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/[1136] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific purity: As explained previously, three causes make the roots of virtue of bodhisattvas on this level extremely pure and powerful:
To give an example, were a fine piece of golden jewelry to be made by a god skilled in crafts, who set it with finest precious gems, and then worn on the head or throat of an empowered king of the gods, it could not be surpassed by any other jewelry of gods or humans. Likewise, the roots of virtue of tenth-level bodhisattvas are so adorned with great pristine awareness that they cannot be excelled by those of any ordinary beings, śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, or bodhisattvas on the ninth level and below.[737]

d.div: [1136] gong mtshungs/ sa bcu pa'i mdo/ shog_273_ba6

f.d: rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ dbang bzhi po de dag las/ las la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs te/ ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i phyir ro/ /

The specific realization: Of the four powers [mentioned above], bodhisattvas at this tenth level realize the state of the power over actions, since they accomplish the welfare of beings just as they wish, through every type of emanation.
The specific things abandoned: See the second level.

skye ba'i khyad par ni/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de lha'i rgyal po dbang phyug chen por 'gyur te/[1137] sems can dang / nyan rang dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos ston pa la mkhas pa'o// de ltar yang / /
de yi rnam par smin pas ni/ / gnas gtsang lha yi bdag por 'gyur/ / bsam yas ye shes yul gyi bdag / dbang phyug chen po mchog yin no/[1138] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The specific state of birth: Most bodhisattvas on this level take birth as the king of the gods, Īśvara, with power over a billionfold world system. They are skilled in teaching the perfections to all sentient beings, śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, /228/ and bodhisattvas:
The full consequence of this is to take birth as lord of the pure-realm[738] gods and as a mighty lord over domains of inconceivable pristine awareness.[739]

[738] The higher five of the seventeen form-realm paradises are known as the “pure realms,” not to be confused with pure lands of buddhas. The highest of those heavens is Akaniṣṭha, or Supreme.
[739] Nāgārjuna, Precious Garland (Ratnāvalī) 5:60, Toh 4158 Tengyur, spring yig, ge, 224a7.

f.d: mthu'i khyad par ni/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam dag la ting nge 'dzin gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs pa sbyar ro/ / gzhan yang ba spu'i khung bu re re las kyang / grangs las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshad med pa dang bcas pa skad cig la ston par nus so/ / lha dang mi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba mang po ston nus so/ / gdul bya gang la gang 'dul du brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / rgyal po dang / nyan rang dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su gnas nas chos ston par nus so/ /

The specific ability: In one instant, a short moment, a small fraction of time, they can enter as many meditative absorptions as there are pure particles in a thousand million million “countless” buddhafields and so forth. Furthermore, in one instant they can manifest from just one pore of their skin countless buddhas in the company of incalculable numbers of bodhisattvas. They can manifest as all sorts of beings—as gods, humans, and so forth. According to whatever is necessary for the training of those to be trained, they can teach Dharma by adopting the physical form of Indra, Brahma, Īśvara, universal guardians, monarchs, śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, or buddhas.

de ltar yang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/
ba spu'i khung nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / grangs med byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bcas dang / / gzhan yang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin/ / skad cig skad cig ston par nus pa yin/[1139] / zhes gsungs so/ /

In Entering the Middle Way, it says:
In one instant they can manifest, from a pore, perfect buddhas in the company of countless bodhisattvas and also gods, humans, and demigods.[740]

[740] Candrakīrti, Madhyamakāvatāra 11:9, Toh 3861 Tengyur, dbu ma, ’a, 216a3.

f.d: byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu bshad zin to//
This completes the explanation of the ten bodhisattva levels.

sangs rgyas kyi sa ni mthar phyin pa'i lam gyi gnas skabs te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pas sgom spang gi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa snying po la yod pa lta bu cig car du spong ba'o/ / de ltar sa de dag kyang / bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis bgrod par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ byang sa las/
de dag thams cad ni bskal pa chen po grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par 'grub ste/ bskal pa chen po grangs med pa dang pos ni/ mos pa spyod pa las yang dag par 'das nas rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa thob ste/ de yang rtag tu 'bad pas thob kyi mi 'bad pas ni ma yin no/[1140] / bskal pa chen po grangs med pa gnyis pas ni/ sa rab tu dga' ba nas sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i bar la 'das te/[1141] [1142] sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba thob par 'gyur ro/ / de ni nges pa kho na ste/ 'di ltar bsam pa dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des nges par 'bad pa'i phyir ro/ / bskal pa chen po grangs med pa gsum pas ni/ sa brgyad pa dang / dgu pa las yang dag par 'das nas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob par 'gyur ro/ / byang sa las/[1143] su brtson 'grus rtsom pa chen pos sbyor ba de'i nang na la la ni bar gyi bskal pa mang po zhig tu 'dums par byed do// la la ni bskal pa chen po dag gi bar du 'dums par byed kyi/ grangs med pa 'dums par byed pa ni 'ga' yang med par rig par bya'o/[1144] / zhes gsungs so/ /

The fifth point describes the level of buddhahood, the final stage of the path. When the diamond-like meditative absorption arises, it eliminates simultaneously the obscurations to be removed by the path of cultivation, that is, any afflictions or knowledge obscurations that remain, comparable to the core.[741] The achievement of this level is described in Bodhisattva Levels:
These levels are accomplished over the span of three countless cosmic eons. During the first great countless eon, [the bodhisattva] traverses the level of practice motivated by aspiration and achieves the state of the Joyous. Further, this is all achieved through constant effort, without which the achievement will not take place. In the second great cosmic eon, [the bodhisattva] transcends the Joyous and works through to the seventh level, the Far-Reaching, to achieve the eighth level, the Unshakable. This is precisely the way it happens because bodhisattvas of pure intention will definitely make these efforts. /229/ In the third great cosmic eon, [the bodhisattva] traverses the eighth and ninth levels and attains the tenth, Cloud of Dharma. Some apply themselves to this most diligently and thereby reduce many sub-eons of progress into one. Some even reduce many eons’ work into one. But there are none who reduce the countless eons into one. It should be known in this way.[742]

f.d: dam chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu thar pa rin po che'i rgyan las/ sa'i rnam bzhag bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //
This concludes the nineteenth chapter, explaining the spiritual levels, of this Ornament of Precious Liberation, a Wish-Fulfilling Gem of Sublime Dharma.
(spyi don lnga pa bla med byang chub grub pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku bshad pa/)
V. The Result
le'u nyi shu pa/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/
20. The Bodies of Perfect Buddhahood

'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku/ /zhes pa la/ de ltar sa lam rnams yongs su bgrod par gyur pa las sku gsum gyi ngang du mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya'o/ / byang chub lam sgron las kyang /
sangs rgyas byang chub yun mi ring /[1145] / zhes gsungs so/ /

To expound the line, “The results are the bodies of perfect buddhahood.”[743] When the paths and the levels have been completely traversed as described above, [the bodhisattva] becomes a perfect buddha within the three bodies (kāya), or “embodiments of enlightenment.” Therefore it says, in Lamp for the Path to Awakening:
Buddhahood and enlightenment no longer remain distant.[744]

d.div: [1145] sde dge_3947_bstan/ dbu ma/ khi_dpal mar me mdzad ye shes/ lam sgron/ sh+loka_59_shog_240_ba5
[743] This is the fifth line of the six-line topical summary presented by the author in the opening section of the text on page 122.
[744] Atiśa, Bodhipathapradīpa verse 59d, Toh 3947 Tengyur, dbu ma, khi, 240b5.

f.d:
sangs rgyas de yang / sdom ni/
rang bzhin sgra don dbye ba dang / / rnam bzhag grangs nges mtshan nyid dang / / khyad par dang ni don bdun gyis/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams bsdus/ / zhes pa'o//

Buddhahood is described in terms of the following synopsis:
The bodies of a perfect buddha are described through seven points: their nature, etymology, aspects, presentation, defi-nite number, characteristic properties, and particularities.
de la dang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni/ spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /
The first point concerns the nature of a truly perfect buddha. It is described through the perfect purity[745] and the perfect pristine awareness.

d.div: [745] The Tibetan spangs pa literally means “abandon,” “renunciation,” or “shedding.” However, to translate this important point as such would be misleading, suggesting deliberate actions of renunciation, of letting go. Such imagery is too gross for what happens here. In this section, we are looking at the end result of a very fine and thorough process of purification that has been going on throughout the bodhisattva levels, using the most refined meditation.

f.d: de la spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / sa dang lam rnams su sun phyung nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jug thogs su ma lus par spangs pa ste/ de yang snyom 'jug gi sgrib pa la sogs pa ni sgrib pa gnyis po de'i dbye bar zad pas/ gnyis po de spangs pas sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa yin no/ /

The perfect purity means that all the affliction and knowledge obscurations, which were being eliminated during the paths and the levels, are completely eliminated subsequent to the diamond-like meditative absorption. Other obscurations, such as those impeding various meditative attainments, are subcategories of the two main obscurations and hence disappear with the elimination of those two.

ye shes phun sum tshogs pa la bzhed pa tha dad de/ de la kha cig na re/ sangs rgyas la rnam rtog kyang mnga'/ ye shes kyang mnga' zhes zer ro/ / kha cig na re sangs rgyas la rnam rtog ni mi mnga' la ci yang sa le mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni mnga' zhes zer ro/[1146] / kha cig na re ye shes rgyun chad pa yin zhes zer ro/ / kha cig na re sangs rgyas la ye shes yod ma myong ba yin zhes zer ro/ /

As for the perfect pristine awareness, there are different views. Some say that buddhas have concepts as well as pristine awareness. Some say that buddhas do not have concepts yet do have pristine awareness, which knows everything clearly. Some say that the continuum of pristine awareness is broken. /230/ Some say that the Buddha has never possessed any such thing as pristine awareness.

d.div: [1146] sa ler/ mi rigs dpe skrun/

f.d:
de yang mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis char gyi gzhung las ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bshad de/ ji skad du/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/
de lta bas na gal te sangs rgyas ye shes mchog / reg par 'dod na rgyal ba'i yum 'dir dad par gyis/[1147] / zhes gsungs so/ /

However, the authoritative texts of the sutras and treatises speak of the pristine awareness of the buddhas. Of the sutras, we find in the Verse Summary of the Perfection of Wisdom:
Therefore, if you want to penetrate the supreme pristine awareness of the buddhas, trust in this, the mother of the conquerors.[746]

d.div: [1147] sde dge_13_bka'/ sher phyin/ ka_mdo sdud pa/ le'u/ 7_sh+loka_7_shog_6_ba2

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las kyang /
yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa ste/[1148] zhes gsungs so/ /

The Perfection of Wisdom in a Hundred Thousand Lines says:
A totally pure and perfect buddha has secured pristine awareness that knows everything without any obscuration.[747]
